SOUND Veterinary Rehabilitation Center is a branch of Animal Surgical and Orthopedic Center (ASOC). The SOUND Rehab Center was designed to provide space for a large gym, two under water treadmills, two exam/ treatment rooms and a dedicated reception area in a non-clinical environment.

Together, SOUND and ASOC are your local experts in rehabilitation, sports medicine, regenerative medicine, pain management, and surgery. We offer the complete package of care for animals with musculoskeletal injuries such as elbow and hip dysplasia, cranial cruciate ligament rupture, arthritis, medial shoulder instability/syndrome, other tendinopathies, bone cancer, post-amputation, and non-surgical or post-surgical neurologic disease.

From the initial diagnosis to long term management of mobility in geriatric patients, SOUND and ASOC offer individualized, comprehensive treatment plans.
